title: The Twelve Brothers
summary: A king had twelve sons, and declared that if his thirteenth child was a daughter, all twelve princes must die so that her inheritance might be boundless....
full_text:
A king had twelve sons, and declared that if his thirteenth child was a daughter, all twelve princes must die so that her inheritance might be boundless.

The good queen warned her sons. Twelve white flags were hoisted on the tower as a signal that a sister was born; and the twelve brothers fled into the deep forest, taking shelter in an enchanted cottage.

When the princess turned ten, she discovered twelve shirts in her mother's chest, learned of her brothers' exile, and vowed to find them. Guided by love, she found their forest cottage and became their devoted little housekeeper.

One morning, wanting to please them, she plucked twelve white lilies blooming in the garden. Instantly, the twelve brothers were transformed into twelve black ravens, who flew away screaming over the treetops, and the cottage vanished!

An old fairy appeared: "You have bewitched your brothers! They can be restored only if you maintain absolute silence for seven years: you must not speak, laugh, or weep. If a single word escapes you, your brothers will die!"

The maiden climbed into a tall oak tree and sat spinning flax in total silence.

A hunting king discovered the beautiful mute maiden, fell in love with her innocence, and made her his queen.

The king's jealous mother accused the silent queen of sorcery and treason, whispering lies that led to her condemnation to the stake.

Even as the flames rose around the execution scaffold, the queen remained steadfastly silent, trusting heaven.

Just as the seventh year expired to the very second, a rushing sound filled the sky! Twelve black ravens swooped down from the clouds, their wings touching the earth.

Instantly, twelve magnificent princes stood before the throne! They extinguished the flames, embraced their devoted sister, and revealed her heroic sacrifice to the king, while the wicked mother-in-law was banished forever.
moral: Pure, patient silence in the face of false accusation possesses the power to redeem.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "The Twelve Brothers"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.
